metadata.title: The Z1 Barrier Panel: Evaluating Foundation MLIPs on 42 Solid-State Electrolyte Chemistries
metadata.deck: A digest-pinned record of the 30-path test panel, the 12-path disjoint training panel, and their published benchmark source.
metadata.evidenceStatus: Source reviewed; campaign-result claims need verification

summary.claim: The Z1 campaign uses a deterministic 30-chemistry test panel and a chemistry-disjoint 12-chemistry correction-training panel derived from the published LiTraj nebDFT2k benchmark.
summary.scope: Panel composition and provenance only; this pack does not certify campaign accuracy or economics.
limitations: LiTraj provides DFT-NEB reference paths, not experimental migration barriers.
The panel locks are repository artifacts whose bytes are pinned here; independent review of campaign results remains needs-verification.
No accuracy, win-rate, cost, or deployment claim is carried into this pack.
summary.lead: The published benchmark source and two immutable repository locks define what was tested and what was reserved for correction fitting.

findings.label: Test panel
findings.text: The frozen test lock contains 30 chemistry-held-out paths selected deterministically from the official test split.

findings.label: Training panel
findings.text: The correction-training lock contains 12 paths and records the full digest of the test lock from which it is chemistry-disjoint.

findings.label: Refusal
findings.text: Campaign-result claims are outside this pack and remain needs-verification.

summary.verdictDetail: Supported for panel identity; open for campaign results.
summary.verdictBody: The two panel files are content-addressed against an exact reviewed repository revision. This establishes panel identity and provenance, not model performance.
summary.orientation: The chart and table summarize the article's panel description. The methodology section carries exact lock URLs and SHA-256 digests.

Chemistry- and material-disjoint from the Z1 test lock

methodology.description: Bind the article's panel description to the independent benchmark paper and to exact repository lock bytes at a reviewed source revision.
steps: Use the published LiTraj nebDFT2k benchmark as the independent source.
Read the test and correction-training lock files from lupine-rhizo revision 8e6abb4d728ea4ea42dab96aa96f693421e90127.
Compute SHA-256 over each complete lock file without rewriting it.
Carry only panel identity and composition; exclude campaign performance and economics.

artifacts.label: Z1 test-panel lock at reviewed revision
Round-5 training-panel lock at reviewed revision

methodology.unitOfAnalysis: One migration path per selected chemical system
methodology.versioning: Exact lupine-rhizo revision plus SHA-256 lock and figure digests
methodology.limitations: Panel locks establish selection and provenance; they do not independently verify model outputs.
transformations: Panel counts are copied from the lock contracts and article; no performance metric is derived.
validation: Exact lock digest comparison at the cited revision
